items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1967-11-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] So I said, Dad, did Master Simon come out and ask him? Did we have a surprise? We have a new drum of the show.

ctx.x: He looked at the cue, you know, all cues. He said, I think I'll play it for you. He said, I'm surprised. I said, I am somewhat surprised.
So I said, Dad, did Master Simon come out and ask him? Did we have a surprise? We have a new drum of the show.
And all the show people's half crazy. Man didn't rehearse the show or anything.
